items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Then in '51 you went out with Ivory Joe Hunter... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Strictly rhythm-and-blues.

ctx.x: So when you played in those bands, did you get many solos? Or was it just mainly playing the riffs?

No, I didn't get no solos much, because I played the show. See, because he had a trumpet player in there, Little Jonesy. He used to play with Basie. He played with Don Redman, too. He was a good trumpet player. He was with him when I went with Ivory. See, I didn't stay with Ivory but about a month. I was playing shows. See, Ivory had a band that played his stuff, but I played the show music. We had four extra guys in the band that played the show with his band, in addition to what he had.
And you were in that group.
Oh yeah. And he did sweet tunes, too. "I Lost My Baby and Almost Lost My Mind" -- that's the one that made him.
